headline: 'I don't know anything' about a weekend strike, hours after his envoy Barrack said 'Absolutely' to a strike 'this weekend
dek: Barrack, asked 'Could there be a strike this weekend?' answered 'Absolutely,' adding it would not aim at regime change but at 'rebalancing'. About 75 minutes later, Trump, asked about Barrack's remark, said: 'If that's the case, I don't know anything about it.' At his Florida rally (~20:05 GMT),…
sources: President Trump responding to reporters (19:15 GMT, via AJ liveblog) vs US Ambassador to Turkiye / Syria-Iraq special envoy Tom Barrack on the Mario Nawfal podcast (18:00 GMT)
fault_line: Who runs US Iran policy — the president or his envoy? And if even Barrack's boss hasn't been briefed, what is the envoy freelancing?
